newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Email says may lift Ampy stake.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Email says may lift Ampy stake.

text.p: Email Ltd Managing Director John Hanna said on Monday the company may increase its stake in British electricity meter maker Ampy Automation Digilog Ltd from its current 20 percent.
"There may be an opportunity to lift that stake in the future," Hanna told Reuters after Email released its half year result.
Hanna would not say if Email would lift the stake soon.

He said Email had spent around A$200 million on acquisitions over the last year, including the November 1995 takeover of Altls Steels Ltd and the Ampy purchase, and remained on the lookout for further acquisitions in its core areas.

These acquisitions had been funded from cash reserves and through securitisation deals, reducing Email's gearing to about 53 percent. "They'd (any further acquisitions) would have to be in existing core areas ... but I don't think we have anything directly in line at the moment," he said.
